items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: They had Sharky Bananas, then they had Peewee out of New York, and then Sharky was from New Orleans.

ctx.x: And so they had three bands on this boat. They had Sharky Bananas, then they had Peewee out of New York, and then Sharky was from New Orleans. And then our band from Chicago.
